全局提示的常规使用方式是通过回调向某个容器输出，每一次输出都会触发一条新的全局提.en-us: Return a message component into a container from a callback. Each output adds a new global message.

通过参数`type`控制全局提示的类型。.en-us: Use `type` to choose the global message type.

通过参数`duration`控制全局提示的显示时长。.en-us: Use `duration` to set how long a global message is displayed.

通过参数`top`控制全局提示的顶端最小像素距离。.en-us: Use `top` to set the global message's minimum top offset in pixels.
